name: tooltip
description: A floating label that appears on hover or focus to provide supplementary context.

tooltip.purpose: Positioned composite with bubble and directional arrow.

openState.trigger: hover or keyboard focus on trigger element
openState.delay: 300ms show delay (system default — overrides Radix's 700ms). Set delayDuration={300} on TooltipProvider at app root.
openState.skipDelay: 300ms — if user moves to a second trigger within 300ms, it opens immediately (skipDelayDuration=300).
openState.hoverableContent: true — tooltip stays open when mouse moves from trigger into content (disableHoverableContent=false default)

animation.description: Fades in with zoom-in-95. Slides in from opposite direction of Side variant.

behavior.scrollBehavior: none — tooltip closes on scroll by default

accessibility.trigger: aria-describedby points from trigger to tooltip id.
accessibility.delay: 300ms system default — set delayDuration={300} on TooltipProvider at app root. Radix ships 700ms but this system overrides it. skipDelayDuration stays at 300ms.

constraints: Text should be one line preferred, two lines maximum.
Do not use tooltips on mobile as the only way to reveal information.
Use Popover when content is interactive.

useCases: Labelling an icon-only button so keyboard and mouse users know what it does ('Archive', 'Share', 'Delete')
Revealing the full text of a truncated cell or label when the container is too narrow to show it
Surfacing a keyboard shortcut hint alongside a toolbar action ('Bold — ⌘B')
Explaining an unfamiliar setting or field label with a one-line definition on hover
Describing what a disabled button requires before it can be activated (wrap in a <span> since disabled elements don't fire hover events)
Adding supplementary context to a data point or metric label without cluttering the UI permanently

Top.whenToUse: Default — use unless there is insufficient space above the trigger

Bottom.whenToUse: Trigger is near the top of the viewport or inside a fixed top bar

Left.whenToUse: Trigger is near the right edge and top/bottom are also constrained

Right.whenToUse: Trigger is near the left edge

comparedTo.situation: The hint contains interactive content (links, buttons, form fields)
comparedTo.notInstead: tooltip (tooltip is read-only; interactive content inside it is inaccessible)

comparedTo.situation: The explanation is long (more than two lines) or needs formatting
comparedTo.notInstead: tooltip (tooltip should be one or two lines max)

comparedTo.situation: The user must act on the information before continuing
comparedTo.notInstead: tooltip (tooltips are purely supplementary and dismissible)

comparedTo.situation: The label is for a mobile touch interface
comparedTo.notInstead: tooltip (hover is unavailable on touch; tooltips are desktop-only)

notes: Tooltip aliases semantic tokens through component tokens — tooltip/bg → color/background/inverted, tooltip/fg → color/background/inverted/foreground. Auto-inverts per mode: dark bubble in light, light bubble in dark.

changelog.change: delayDuration changed from Radix default 700ms to system default 300ms. Set delayDuration={300} on TooltipProvider. Documented in Tooltip.md and tooltip.meta.json accessibility.delay.

darkMode.notes: Tooltip auto-inverts: Light = zinc/900 bg / white text, Dark = zinc/50 bg / black text. Achieved via color/background/inverted semantic alias — no component-level dark override needed.
